This file is a standard systemd service unit file for SonarQube, containing only legitimate service configuration. It declares a forking service running as the `sonarqube` user/group, sets reasonable resource limits (`LimitNOFILE=65536`, `LimitNPROC=4096`), and references the upstream `sonar.sh` startup scripts under `/usr/share/webapps/sonarqube/`. There are no network downloads, no obfuscated code, no unexpected file operations, and no dangerous commands such as eval or curl. The unit file does not execute or fetch any code itself—it simply instructs systemd how to manage the SonarQube process. The `Documentation=http://www.sonarqube.org` line uses plain HTTP instead of HTTPS, which is a trivial hygiene observation only and does not constitute a security threat (it has no effect on package behavior). This is consistent with ordinary Arch packaging practice for a systemd unit file, which typically ships alongside a PKGBUILD.
